titanSays.line: 📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"
🔭 Scouts come back pale. The sky looks wrong. Not cloudy, not dark — just... bigger. Like it's closer than it should be.
📻 The old ones point at the horizon and don't speak. The System, for once, is quiet too. Then: the Herald. It heralds the apocalypse the way dawn heralds the day.
📯 MUSTER — scouts report The Audit hunting near Haven, and it is beyond us. Everyone inside. No one walks the treeline alone — the garden crews double up, the hunters stand down. We outlast it.
🗺️ Scouts found its lair — tile 7,4. THE HERALD — the sky, getting bigger. It is WAITING. You cannot face it alone. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Stonebridge in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
You turn to leave — behind you, The Herald stirs.
The Herald stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Stonebridge in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
You turn to leave — behind you, The Herald stirs.
It followed you. The Herald is here.
You turn to leave — behind you, The Herald stirs.
The Herald stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
🌪️ THE HERALD fed in the night — 900 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (The Callback, Ugly-Eyes, The Herald) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.
🐗⚠️ One of them is bigger than the usual teeth at the door — The Herald came with this raid, and the wall was not built for its kind.

🚨 The Callback, Ugly-Eyes, The Herald is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
Nobody met The Herald — it's still out there at the treeline. It'll gorge every night until it's driven off.

⛔ THE HERALD does not notice you the way prey notices a hunter. It notices you the way weather notices a field. You cannot face this alone — sound the call, muster 10 allied blades (you have 0). This is not courage. This is arithmetic.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Herald gorges at the treeline — 1,000 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
🌙 Night. The lingering The Herald circles the treeline, sniffing at empty stores — nothing left to take. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
